title: Placement: Digital Root (Single Digit Sum)
description: Given an integer `n`, repeatedly add all its digits until the result has only one digit, and return it (also known as the Digital Root).
constraints:
0 <= n <= 10^9
• Time: O(1) or O(log N) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Congruence formula: For any base 10 integer, digital root is n mod 9 (or 9 if non-zero multiple of 9).
